summary.text: Stan Clouse is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 37, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.

paragraphs.text: Stan Clouse was born on December 4, 1956, in North Platte.
Stan Clouse graduated from Brady Public Schools in 1975 and earned an associate degree from Mid-Plains Community College in 1996.
Stan Clouse served as mayor of Kearney from 2006 to 2024 and on the Kearney City Council from 2003 to 2024.
Stan Clouse is a member of the Kearney Noon Rotary Club and the Kearney Area Chamber of Commerce.
Stan Clouse married LaVon Cole on September 16, 2023, and has two children.
